reason: I want to take the garden greens aboard; packing them in the meal box is the only offered action and fits the goal.
expectation: The greens will be packed as a flight meal, perhaps completing the goal.

effect: The greens became a fresh flight meal, completing the goal and bringing the chapter to a close.
reaction: The image of leaves beside the ice is a quietly satisfying link between the garden and discovery; the action itself was entirely predictable.

mostWorthwhile.text: Packing the greens and seeing them placed beside the ice made the two strands of the expedition feel connected in a small, human way.

leastWorthwhile.text: The sole combination was straightforward and offered no real decision or discovery; it worked more as a closing gesture than a puzzle.

surprise.text: Nothing in the action surprised me; the pairing of the leaves and the ice made the departure feel more personal.

arbitrary.text: No: putting washed greens in a meal box clearly serves the stated goal, although it was the only option.

continue.text: Yes, I would be curious to see how Earth receives the preserved body, though this short closing chapter itself offered little gameplay to draw me onward.
